_meta.why: L99 — one energy compensation stack; Homey 64MB; no parallel invent
_meta.track: BOTH for runtime energy SSOT; CI reports MASTER_ONLY; see dual-app-tracks.json
_meta.p2672: IntelligentEnergyAdapter is the fleet entry — dynamic mode per device before SmartEnergy audit

roles.IntelligentEnergyAdapter: P2672 — resolve metered|approximate|battery|mains_sensor from clusters+driver+couple; setEnergy + strip phantoms; skip ZCL energy bind when approximate.
roles.SmartDivisorManager: SSOT for DP/ZCL scale (KNOWN_DIVISORS + LEARNED + range detect). Buffer JSON elsewhere; never hardcode /100 twice.
roles.EnergyJumpGuard: Defensive meter_power jump filter; sticky factor; syncs rememberLearnedDivisor when _energyParseMeta set.
roles.SmartEnergyManager: 5-min real vs estimated audit; never overwrite direct with estimated; boots IntelligentEnergyAdapter first.
roles.VirtualEnergyMeterMixin: Nominal-power estimates after audit silence; mainsPowered; no energy.approximation+meter compose.
roles.HomeyGapCompensator: Soft ensure/notes only — never adds measure_power/meter_power phantoms.
roles.UniversalEnergyHandler: Owned by SmartEnergyManager after audit promote; skipped when adapter.skipZclEnergyBind.

modes.metered: Real electricalMeasurement/metering or plug/socket driver — keep measure_* caps
modes.approximate: Mains lighting/switch without meter (HOBEIAN ZG-301Z etc.) — strip power caps + setEnergy(approximation)
modes.mains_sensor: Mains radar/presence — approximation, no battery phantoms
